snippet.title: The Aurora Chronicles - Episode 2: The Garden | Trailer
snippet.description:
Episode 2: The Garden launches end of April 2026 on Steam.

Six months ago, the New Eden outpost went silent. Two hundred residents are alive, healthy, and content. That's the problem. The Aurora crew arrives to find out what happened.

Early Access launches end of April 2026 with Episodes 1 and 2 on Steam. Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4262410/The_Aurora_Chronicles/

The Aurora Chronicles is an episodic sci-fi visual novel following a four-person crew investigating frontier mysteries aboard the FRV Aurora. Your choices shape relationships, leadership style, and what the crew uncovers.

Full English voice acting. Original soundtrack.

Follow development:
X: https://x.com/entropy_42_
Soundtrack: https://aurorachronicles.bandcamp.com/

#visualnovel #indiegame #scifi #indiedev
